## Description

**What**: Author behavioral test suite covering: (1) conditional load per-skill — non-Strata zero Reads; brainstorm Phase 1 Step 1 reads concepts + brainstorm-guidance ≤80 lines; on-demand decomposition.md when STRATA_UNCERTAINTY fires; preplanning tag-scoped Reads; implementation-plan tag inheritance via story→epic chain; strata.skip=true blocks all SDK Reads; STRATA_SKIP env var inherited by sub-agents; STRATA_SKIP absent treated as false (fail-open). (2) Brainstorm tag set/unset across canonical inputs ("intake form for SNAP applicants" yes; "deployment pipeline for Strata project" no); UX disclosure printed; correction path documented; ≤80 line cap at Phase 1 Step 1; read-after-write fence (preplanning's first action verifies tag with retry + named error). (3) Plan-validation: bad-fixture plan with 4 footguns produces ≥4 findings citing decomposition.md rules; non-Strata epic produces byte-identical scrutiny output (diff against tests/fixtures/scrutiny-non-strata-baseline.txt exits 0). (4) Parallel reviewers shared facts load (no duplicate Read in tool-use logs). (5) Regeneration round-trip + manual-residual-index.json integrity. (6) Implementation-plan task output references SDK generator commands with hyphenated flags. Plus pre-sprint-gate behavioral test at tests/scripts/test-b-pre-sprint-gate.sh against fixture with/without spike artifact.
**Why**: 5 behavioral guarantees + 6 SCs need observable failure modes; RED tests are the contract.
**Scope**:
- IN: All test scripts, fixture directories, golden-master facts files, scrutiny-non-strata-baseline.txt, bad-fixture with 4 SDK footguns, pre-sprint gate test.
- OUT: Implementation of regeneration tool, per-skill loads, plan-validation extension (separate stories).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, all behavioral test scripts authored ← Satisfies: SC1-SC6
- When complete, tests confirmed FAILING (RED); RED comment recorded ← Satisfies: SC1-SC6
- When complete, fixtures (Strata Rails, non-Strata, bad-plan-with-4-footguns, scrutiny-non-strata-baseline) committed ← Satisfies: SC2, SC4
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for any harness helpers introduced

## Considerations
- [Testing] RED-first; tests authored before any impl
- [Reliability] Tests must isolate from production reviewer infra (sandbox/mock)
- [Testing] Token-count assertion ≤80 lines is structural; assert via wc -l + verify content sample

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Write failing behavioral tests for Strata SDK planning context (5 guarantees + 6 SCs)
